name: panel-prepower
summary: Power the panel up (backlight off) during start-up so only the backlight step remains when the input is ready

edits.asm: panel-prepower code in linker padding (0x203A00); flags PRE/PREQ at 0x203FF0/0x203FF1
b.lbz r6,0x51a8(r10) -> b.j 0x203a00 (sub_245919 entry: lbz r6,pnl -> prepared-panel check)
b.movhi r6,0x48 -> b.j 0x203a24 (sub_245919 tail: stop before re-detect/backlight when preparing)
b.sb 0x51a8(r7),r0 -> b.j 0x203a46 (sub_245860: clear PRE with pnl)
b.jal 0x268c55 -> b.jal 0x203a56 (boot: prepare panel, then sub_268C55)

notes: At boot (0x2620CC, where the stock logo powered the panel) the vendor panel-on runs with the backlight held off; the later panel-on from mode setup only does the re-detect check and backlight-on. Panel-off clears the state. The vendor already keeps the panel powered across mode changes (No signal -> picture), so the panel sees the same transition as stock. Boot is blocked for the panel sequence (~0.6-0.8 s) as with the stock logo. Generated by tools/patches_src_panel_prepower.py.
